matched.runner:
"""Compare isolated board-profile passes after identical startup phases."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TREE = OUTPUT.parent / "worktree"
INCLUDE = OUTPUT.parents[2] / ".deps/rtl/oss-cad-suite/share/verilator/include"
EMPTY_ONLY = "--empty" in sys.argv[2:]
DRIVER = OUTPUT / ("isolated-empty.cpp" if EMPTY_ONLY else "isolated.cpp")
MODELS = {"before": OUTPUT / "baseline/build/tang20k-core-sim",
          "after": TREE / "build/tang20k-core-sim"}
SCENES = ("ui-store", "ui-discard", "ui-load", "pointer", "copy", "showcase",
          "perspective", "overdraw", "opaque", "ico", "ico-flat", "closeup", "vertex0", "vertex1", "empty-discard")


def measure(label):
    model = MODELS[label]
    obj = model / "obj"
    source_tree = OUTPUT / "baseline" if label == "before" else TREE
    suffix = "-final"
    exe = OUTPUT / f"{label}-isolated{suffix}.exe"
    names = ("setup", "renderer", "demo", "hw_protocol", "sdram_model",
             "verilated", "verilated_dpi", "verilated_vcd_c", "verilated_threads")
    objects = [obj / f"{name}.o" for name in names]
    objects.append(obj / "Vnano_gpu_core__ALL.a")
    flags = ["-std=c++17", "-O2", "-pthread", "-DVL_TIME_CONTEXT=1",
             "-DNANO_GPU_ORACLE_ONLY=1", "-DNANO_GPU_BOARD_PROFILE=1",
             "-DVM_TRACE=1", "-DVM_TRACE_VCD=1", "-DVM_TRACE_FST=0"]
    includes = (obj, INCLUDE, INCLUDE / "vltstd", source_tree / "reference/include", source_tree / "reference/rtl")
    subprocess.run(["g++", *flags, *(f"-I{path}" for path in includes),
                    str(DRIVER), *map(str, objects), "-o", str(exe)], check=True)
    cases = []
    for scene in (("empty-discard",) if EMPTY_ONLY else SCENES):
        for offset in (0, 700000):
            stats = OUTPUT / f"{label}-final-{scene}-{offset}.json"
            subprocess.run([str(exe), scene, str(offset), str(stats)], check=True)
            cases.append(json.loads(stats.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    report = {"build": json.loads((model / "build-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
              "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(DRIVER.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "exe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "cases": cases}
    (OUTPUT / f"{label}-matched{suffix}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


measure(sys.argv[1])

nominal_current_firmware_host_control.scope: Average 125 virtual host cycles per 336 core cycles. Models logical bus availability only. The current firmware's programmed PIO rate includes divider rounding and actual submissions also incur RP2350 software overhead.
nominal_current_firmware_host_control.driver_generator:
"""Measure the same submission using a cadenceer virtual host on the board core."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
model = sys.argv[1]
source = HERE / ("baseline" if model == "before" else "../worktree") / "reference/rtl/main.cpp"
main = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = "const bool next_host = (cycles & 1u) != 0;"
assert main.count(old) == 1
main = main.replace(old, "const bool next_host = ((cycles * 125u) % 336u) >= 168u;")
(HERE / f"{model}-cadence-main.cpp").write_text(main, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
driver = (HERE / "isolated.cpp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert driver.count('#include "main.cpp"') == 1
driver = driver.replace('#include "main.cpp"', f'#include "{model}-cadence-main.cpp"')
(HERE / f"{model}-cadence.cpp").write_text(driver, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
runner = (HERE / "run-matched.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
runner = runner.replace('DRIVER = OUTPUT / ("isolated-empty.cpp" if EMPTY_ONLY else "isolated.cpp")',
                        'DRIVER = OUTPUT / f"{sys.argv[1]}-cadence.cpp"')
runner = runner.replace('suffix = "-empty" if EMPTY_ONLY else ""', 'suffix = "-cadence"')
runner = runner.replace('(("empty-discard",) if EMPTY_ONLY else SCENES)',
                        '("ui-store", "ui-discard", "showcase", "copy")')
runner = runner.replace('f"{label}-{scene}-{offset}.json"', 'f"{label}-cadence-{scene}-{offset}.json"')
runner = runner.replace('in (0, 700000):', 'in (0,):')
(HERE / "run-cadence.py").write_text(runner, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

slower_host_control.scope: Only the cycle-driven logical host changes frequency. This is not the RP2350 CPU, its PIO software pacing or an electrical measurement.
